title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Training Note: Reconnect Fee History and the Carried-In Credit Reserve Days
content:
**Rule.** For a credit balance carried into PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), where the enrolled service account was billed two or more reconnect fees in the twenty-four-month window, the reserve days are increased by 6; where it was billed exactly one, the reserve days are increased by 3; with none the reserve days are not increased for reconnections.

The count is taken from the reconnect fees billed on the enrolled service account in its Electric Service by Rate Schedule records. The twenty-four-month window takes the fees dated after the same day of the month twenty-four months before the current date, through the current date.

### Questions answered

**The enrolled account was billed one reconnect fee eighteen months ago. What happens to the reserve days?** Eighteen months lies within the twenty-four-month window and the count is exactly one, so the reserve days are increased by 3.

**It was billed two reconnect fees, one five months ago and one twenty months ago.** Both lie within the window; two or more gives an increase of 6.

**Its only reconnect fee is dated twenty-six months ago.** It is outside the window, so the reserve days are not increased for reconnections.

**Does a reconnect fee on another of the member's service accounts count?** No. The rule counts the reconnect fees billed on the enrolled service account.

| Reconnect fees in the twenty-four-month window | Reserve days |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | increased by 6 |
| exactly 1 | increased by 3 |
| none | not increased for reconnections |
